name: RoProxy Lite
description: A modified version of RoProxy made for self-hosting.

KEY.description: The key used to access proxy.

TIMEOUT.description: The number of seconds before a request times out and is retried.

RETRIES.description: The maximum number of times to attempt a request. Minimum: 1

FOLLOWING_CACHE_MINUTES.description: Minutes to cache each player's follower verification result.

FOLLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Comma-separated Roblox user IDs whose followers are allowed. Defaults to the two configured IDs.
